mn71:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
mn71:2.1: tena kho pana samayena vacchagotto paribbājako ekapuṇḍarīke paribbājakārāme paṭivasati.
mn71:3.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya vesāliṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn71:3.3: atippago kho tāva vesāliyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
mn71:3.4: yannūnāhaṃ yena ekapuṇḍarīko paribbājakārāmo yena vacchagotto paribbājako tenupasaṅkameyyanti.
mn71:3.5: atha kho bhagavā yena ekapuṇḍarīko paribbājakārāmo yena vacchagotto paribbājako tenupasaṅkami.
mn71:4.1: addasā kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ dūrato āgacchantaṃ
mn71:4.5: cirassaṃ kho bhante bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya
mn71:4.8: vacchagottopi kho paribbājako aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn71:4.9: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn71:5.2: samaṇo gotamo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti
mn71:5.3: carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti
mn71:5.4: ye te bhante evamāhaṃsu samaṇo gotamo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti kacci te bhante bhagavato vuttavādino na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchatīti.
mn71:5.5: ye te vaccha evamāhaṃsu samaṇo gotamo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitanti na me te vuttavādino abbhācikkhanti ca pana mante asatā abhūtenāti.
mn71:6.1: kathaṃ byākaramānā pana mayaṃ bhante vuttavādino ceva bhagavato assāma na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyyāma dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyyāma na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
mn71:6.2: tevijjo samaṇo gotamoti kho vaccha byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyya.
mn71:7.1: ahaṃ hi vaccha yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi
mn71:7.2: seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
mn71:8.1: ahaṃ hi vaccha yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi.
mn71:9.1: ahaṃ hi vaccha āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmi.
mn71:10.1: tevijjo samaṇo gotamoti kho vaccha byākaramāno vuttavādī ceva me assa na ca maṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākareyya na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānuvādo gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
mn71:11.1: evaṃ vutte vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn71:11.2: atthi nu kho bho gotama koci gihī gihisaññojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhassantakaroti.
mn71:11.3: natthi kho vaccha koci gihī gihisaññojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhassantakaroti.
mn71:12.1: atthi pana bho gotama koci gihī gihisaññojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā saggūpagoti.
mn71:12.2: na kho vaccha ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni atha kho bhiyyova ye gihī gihisaññojanaṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā saggūpagāti.
mn71:13.1: atthi nu kho bho gotama koci ājīvako kāyassa bhedā dukkhassantakaroti.
mn71:13.2: natthi kho vaccha koci ājīvako kāyassa bhedā dukkhassantakaroti.
mn71:14.1: atthi pana bho gotama koci ājīvako kāyassa bhedā saggūpagoti.
mn71:14.2: ito kho so vaccha ekanavuto kappo yamahaṃ anussarāmi nābhijānāmi kañci ājīvakaṃ saggūpagaṃ aññatra ekena
mn71:15.1: evaṃ sante bho gotama suññaṃ aduṃ titthāyatanaṃ antamaso saggūpagenāti.
mn71:15.2: evaṃ vaccha suññaṃ aduṃ titthāyatanaṃ antamaso saggūpagenāpīti.
mn71:15.4: attamano vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
